home.lead: Random bearer keys and SHA-256 digests, a typed capability-grant vocabulary, and a tenant-scoped key store with issuance, verification and lifecycle, for services issuing invite codes or API keys.

example.title: Issue a key and its digest
example.caption: Creates a prefixed bearer key and its SHA-256 digest in one call, then prints that the key carries the prefix and the digest is 64 hex characters.

start.title: Quickstart
start.description: Issue a key, store its digest and hand the key to its one recipient.

start.title: Core concepts
start.description: What generateKey, hashKey and generateKeyAndHash each return.

tasks.title: Issue a key and its digest together
tasks.description: generateKeyAndHash returns { key, digest } in one call.

tasks.title: Hash a key you already generated
tasks.description: hashKey returns a key's SHA-256 digest as lowercase hex.

tasks.title: Declare a capability-grant vocabulary
tasks.description: defineGrants builds the typed grant and scope schemas, and canonicalGrants, grantsAllow, grantsList and isSubset over your capability names.

tasks.title: Run a tenant-scoped key store
tasks.description: createKeyStore issues, verifies and manages bearer keys: CAS grant edits, revocation, optional expiry, suspension and rate limits.

reference.description: generateKey/hashKey; defineGrants at /api/grants/; createKeyStore at /api/keys/; fromNodeSqlite at /api/keys-node/.
